question: 'Patna Kalam' is a:
solution:
The correct answer is __**style of painting**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Patna Kalam** is a style of painting that originated in Bihar, India.
 
• This style is known for its unique blend of Mughal and local Indian art forms, and it flourished during the 18th and 19th centuries.
 
• Patna Kalam paintings are characterized by their detailed and realistic depiction of everyday life, nature, and historical events.
 
• The artists of Patna Kalam used natural colors and were skilled in creating intricate designs and patterns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Patna Kalam** is also known as **Patna School of Painting**.
 
• It is a subset of the broader Mughal painting tradition but with distinct local influences that make it unique.
 
• The subjects of Patna Kalam paintings often include scenes from daily life, festivals, and rural activities, reflecting the socio-cultural environment of the time.
 
• This art form played a significant role in the cultural heritage of Bihar and continues to be celebrated for its historical and artistic value.
 
• Notable artists of this style include **Sahib Ram, Hulas Lal, and Shiv Lal**, who contributed significantly to its development and popularity.
